text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, bumetanide injection is listed on FDA's shortage list as Resolved with an initial posting on 2017-12-13 and a last update on 2026-09-30. Multiple manufacturers — MSN Laboratories Private Limited, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals — are all marked Resolved. Current hospital inventory shows 1.4 to 38.2 days on hand across presentations and sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows bumetanide injection as Resolved since 2017-12-13, last updated 2026-09-30. An FDA inspection of a Zydus Lifesciences Limited plant (FEI 3005430968) ended 2015-05-23 and was classified VAI, 935 days before the 2017-12-13 posting. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) has a series of VAI inspections from 2009 through 2024, with the most recent ending 2024-06-12. Zydus Lifesciences Limited received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02.

Our position: The shortage is resolved per FDA records, but inventory remains low for several presentations. The best rule-based option is to buy from Advagen Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Advagen Pharma Limited; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate AvPAK as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor inventory weekly and report to P&T Committee; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
